title: The Grandest Game in the World
author: John Dickson Carr
note: Originally written in London in 1946 as Carr's introduction to the anthology 'The Ten Best Detective Novels'; reprinted with the 'Second Thoughts—After 17 Years' postscript in Ellery Queen's Mystery Magazine, March 1963. Text extracted from 'The Door to Doom and Other Detections', edited by Douglas G. Greene (New York: Harper & Row, 1980). The closing block-quoted paragraph is an afterword by the editor, Douglas G. Greene, not part of Carr's essay. Page numbers were not available from the source e-book.
